Create a configuration template

Source: R/configure.R
create_configuration_template.Rd

Builds a pipeline-agnostic baseline configuration with neutral path placeholders and registry-derived default trait and policy selections.

Usage

create_configuration_template(
  input_file = "input.xlsx",
  output_root = "outputs",
  cache_folder = "cache",
  registry_path = NULL,
  policy_path = NULL
)

Arguments

input_file

Placeholder input workbook path. The workbook is not read.

output_root

Output root directory.

cache_folder

Cache folder.

registry_path

Optional trait-registry path used to derive default trait names.

policy_path

Optional policy-registry path used to derive one default active policy.

Value

A config list.
